content.short: Punk Domains is a permissionless Web3 names protocol for DAOs and NFT communities.
content.description: Online identity is a foundational element of a fully decentralized Web3 future. Web3 names act as readable wallet addresses and usernames, and can also carry data such as a homepage URL, image data, and email address. Punk Domains enables any Web3 community to create its own domain extension, helping communities establish distinct, recognizable identities within the broader ecosystem. By supporting customizable extensions, it offers a flexible framework for naming and identity across chains and communities.
